description: Domain services, auth controllers, authorization (policies + middleware enforcement), and the event/listener notification pipeline. Depends on FEAT-001 (models, migrations, middleware registration must exist).
steps: 1. Create app/Exceptions/InvalidStatusTransitionException.php: extends RuntimeException, holds from/to statuses, message 'Invalid status transition from {from} to {to}'.

2. Create app/Services/AuditLogger.php: static or injectable helper with log(string $action, ?Model $subject, array $meta, ?User $actor) that creates an AuditLog record with actor_id, action, subject_type (get_class), subject_id, meta_json (sanitized — no secrets), ip_address from request(), created_at now().

3. Create app/Services/TrackingNumberService.php: generate(int $year): string. Inside DB::transaction(): upsert number_sequences row for scope='tracking'+year (INSERT on first use at last_value=1, else UPDATE last_value = last_value + 1), read the new value, format as sprintf('%s-%d-%06d', config('permit.tracking_prefix'), $year, $seq). Return formatted string. The calling code (ApplicationWorkflowService::submit) wraps this in a bounded retry loop (up to 5 attempts catching unique-constraint QueryException).
4. Create app/Services/PermitNumberService.php: same pattern as TrackingNumberService with scope='permit' and config('permit.permit_prefix').

5. Create app/Services/ApplicationWorkflowService.php: owns the status machine. TRANSITIONS constant maps from->to pairs exactly per design. transition(Application $app, string $to, ?User $actor, ?string $note): validates pair, updates $app->status, sets timestamps (submitted_at on SUBMITTED, reviewed_at on BPLO actions), writes ApplicationStatusHistory and AuditLog, fires the matching domain event — all inside DB::transaction(). Throws InvalidStatusTransitionException on illegal pairs. Convenience methods: submit($app, $actor) — generates tracking number via TrackingNumberService with retry loop, transitions DRAFT->SUBMITTED or FOR_CORRECTION->SUBMITTED; beginReview($app, $actor); approveForPayment($app, $actor); returnForCorrection($app, $actor, $remark) — creates ApplicationRemark type CORRECTION; reject($app, $actor, $remark) — creates ApplicationRemark type REJECTION; markPaymentPending($app, $actor); markPaymentVerified($app, $actor); releasePermit($app, $actor) — calls PermitService::release().
6. Create app/Support/FeeBreakdown.php: simple DTO / array-like class with 'lines' (array of ['code','name','amount']) and 'total' (decimal sum).

7. Create app/Services/FeeComputationService.php: computeFor(Application $app): FeeBreakdown. Reads active fee_rates joined to active fee_types ordered by sort_order. Builds line items + summed total. Logs warning if no active rates. Returns FeeBreakdown.
8. Create app/Contracts/PaymentGateway.php: interface with initiate(Payment $p): array and verify(Payment $p, array $callback): array.
9. Create app/Contracts/SmsChannel.php: interface with send(string $to, string $message): array.

10. Create app/Services/SandboxGateway.php implements PaymentGateway: initiate() sets payment status to PROCESSING, generates SANDBOX-{uuid} reference, creates PaymentTransaction(event:initiated, gateway:sandbox), returns ['status'=>'processing','reference'=>ref]. NEVER returns PAID/success. verify() validates callback, sets payment status to PAID, verification_status to VERIFIED, payment_date+verified_at, creates PaymentTransaction(event:verified), returns ['status'=>'paid'].

11. Create app/Services/PaymentService.php: startPayment(Application $app, string $method): Payment — guards $app->status === APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT, calls FeeComputationService for breakdown, creates Payment(PENDING) with snapshot, calls gateway->initiate(), transitions app to PAYMENT_PENDING via workflow service. verify(Payment $payment, array $callback, ?User $actor): void — calls gateway->verify(), on success transitions app to PAYMENT_VERIFIED, fires PaymentConfirmed. On failure sets FAILED, transitions app back to APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT. Resolve gateway from container keyed on config('permit.payment.mode').

12. Create app/Services/PermitService.php: release(Application $app, ?User $actor): Permit — guards $app->status === PAYMENT_VERIFIED, generates permit_number via PermitNumberService (with retry), generates 64-char verification_token (Str::random(64), check unique), snapshots business fields, sets issued_at=today, valid_until=issued_at+config('permit.valid_months') months, renders+stores PDF, creates Permit record, transitions app to PERMIT_RELEASED. renderPdf(Permit $permit): string — renders Blade view permits.pdf with dompdf, stores on local disk at permits/{permit_id}.pdf, returns path. qrDataUri(string $url): string — generates SVG via QrCode::format('svg')->size(200)->generate($url), returns 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,'.base64_encode($svg). regenerate(Permit $permit, ?User $actor): Permit — issues fresh token + re-renders PDF, audits, does not change permit_number.
13. Create app/Services/LogSmsChannel.php implements SmsChannel: send() writes to Laravel Log::info() with to+message, returns ['status'=>'logged'].

14. Create app/Services/NotificationService.php: notify(User $user, string $type, string $title, string $body, ?Application $application): void — creates Notification record (channel in_app). If user has contact_number and config('permit.sms.driver') !== null, resolves SmsChannel from container and sends, recording sms_status.

15. Create domain events in app/Events/: ApplicationSubmitted, ApplicationUnderReview, ApplicationReturnedForCorrection, ApplicationApprovedForPayment, PaymentConfirmed, PermitReleased, ApplicationRejected. Each carries the Application + optional User actor.

16. Create app/Listeners/SendStatusNotification.php: handles all 7 events. Maps event class to notification type/title/body templates. Calls NotificationService::notify() for the applicant. Does NOT implement ShouldQueue — synchronous.

17. Register service bindings in app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php: bind PaymentGateway => SandboxGateway (when config permit.payment.mode is sandbox), bind SmsChannel => LogSmsChannel (when config permit.sms.driver is log). Register event-listener mappings if not using auto-discovery.

18. Create app/Policies/ApplicationPolicy.php: view/update/submit — applicant may act only on own application in editable status (DRAFT, FOR_CORRECTION). review — BPLO/admin only. Registered via auto-discovery.
19. Create app/Policies/PaymentPolicy.php: pay — own application in APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT status. view — own or BPLO/admin.
20. Create app/Policies/PermitPolicy.php: download — owning applicant or BPLO/admin. No update/edit ability exists for anyone.

21. Create auth controllers in app/Http/Controllers/Auth/: RegisterController (GET show form, POST store — force role=applicant, validate via RegisterRequest, create user, login, redirect to /dashboard). LoginController (GET show form, POST authenticate with throttle, validate via LoginRequest, check is_active, Auth::attempt, redirect by role. POST destroy logout). PasswordResetController (GET/POST forgot-password, GET/POST reset-password using built-in password broker).

22. Create Form Requests in app/Http/Requests/Auth/: RegisterRequest (name required string max:255, email required email unique:users, password required confirmed min:8 with mixed case + number). LoginRequest (email required, password required).
acceptance_criteria: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed succeeds with all services resolvable from the container
ApplicationWorkflowService rejects illegal transitions by throwing InvalidStatusTransitionException
PermitService::release() throws when application is not PAYMENT_VERIFIED
LogSmsChannel writes to the Laravel log and returns 'logged'
Auth register forces role=applicant regardless of input
ApplicationPolicy denies non-owners and wrong-status access
All events/listeners are registered — php artisan event:list shows them
verification: php artisan event:list (shows all 7 events mapped to SendStatusNotification)
php artisan route:list (auth routes appear with no errors)
findings: COMPLETED. All domain services, auth controllers, policies, events/listeners, and container bindings implemented. Verification green: config:clear + migrate:fresh --seed clean; event:list shows all 7 events -> SendStatusNotification; route:list shows auth routes; php artisan test = 20 passed (37 assertions). Pint passes on all new files. Notes for later FEATs (controllers/UI/routes): SERVICES (app/Services): - TrackingNumberService::generate(int $year) / PermitNumberService::generate(int $year): atomic `UPDATE number_sequences SET last_value = last_value + 1` inside DB::transaction(); first-use creates the row at last_value=1. No lockForUpdate. Formats BANSUD-2025-000001 / BP-2025-000001. The RETRY LOOP lives in the CALLER, not these services: ApplicationWorkflowService::assignTrackingNumber() and PermitService::createPermitRecord() each catch QueryException up to 5 attempts. - ApplicationWorkflowService: public const TRANSITIONS (from=>[to...]) exactly matches the design table (incl. SUBMITTED->REJECTED and UNDER_REVIEW->REJECTED, PAYMENT_PENDING->APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT retry). transition($app,$to,$actor,$note) validates, sets status + submitted_at (on SUBMITTED, once) + reviewed_at (on BPLO actions UNDER_REVIEW/FOR_CORRECTION/APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT/REJECTED), writes ApplicationStatusHistory + AuditLog('application.status_changed'), fires the matching event, all in ONE DB::transaction(). Convenience: submit/beginReview/approveForPayment/returnForCorrection($app,$actor,$remark)/reject($app,$actor,$remark)/markPaymentPending/markPaymentVerified/releasePermit (delegates to PermitService::release via app()). NOTE: application_remarks.author_id is NOT NULL in schema, so returnForCorrection/reject REQUIRE a non-null $actor (BPLO/admin) — controllers must pass the authenticated staff user. - PaymentService::startPayment($app,$method,$actor=null) guards APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT (throws RuntimeException otherwise), snapshots FeeBreakdown into breakdown_json, creates Payment(PENDING), calls gateway->initiate() (-> PROCESSING + SANDBOX-{uuid} ref), transitions app to PAYMENT_PENDING. verify(Payment,$callback,$actor=null) is the ONLY path to PAYMENT_VERIFIED: on gateway 'paid' sets verified_by (if actor), transitions app PAYMENT_VERIFIED, fires PaymentConfirmed; on failure sets Payment FAILED, writes payment_transactions(event:failed), returns app to APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT. Gateway resolved via match(config('permit.payment.mode')). - SandboxGateway::initiate() sets PROCESSING + SANDBOX-{uuid}, writes PaymentTransaction(event:initiated), returns ['status'=>'processing','reference'=>ref] — NEVER paid. verify() sets PAID+VERIFIED+payment_date+verified_at, writes PaymentTransaction(event:verified), returns ['status'=>'paid']. - PermitService::release($app,$actor=null) guards PAYMENT_VERIFIED (throws RuntimeException otherwise), generates permit_number (retry) + unique 64-char Str::random token, snapshots business fields (owner_name = application.applicant_name), issued_at=today start-of-day, valid_until=+config('permit.valid_months'), renders+stores PDF at permits/{id}.pdf on 'local' disk, transitions PERMIT_RELEASED. qrDataUri($url) = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,'.base64_encode(QrCode::format('svg')->size(200)->generate($url)) — SVG ONLY. renderPdf uses Pdf::loadView('permits.pdf',...). regenerate() issues fresh token + re-renders PDF, keeps permit_number, audited. - FeeComputationService::computeFor($app): FeeBreakdown — joins active fee_rates+fee_types ordered by sort_order; empty set => zero total + Log::warning. FeeBreakdown DTO (app/Support/FeeBreakdown.php) is Arrayable with ->lines [{code,name,amount}] and ->total; ::fromLines() sums. - NotificationService::notify(User,$type,$title,$body,?Application) writes in_app Notification row; if user->contact_number && config('permit.sms.driver')!==null resolves SmsChannel and sends inline, records sms_status (logged/failed). LogSmsChannel::send() -> Log::info + returns ['status'=>'logged']. - AuditLogger::log($action,?Model $subject,array $meta,?User $actor): sets actor_id, action, subject_type/id, meta_json (null if empty), ip from request(), created_at now(). EVENTS/LISTENERS: 7 events in app/Events (ApplicationSubmitted/UnderReview/ReturnedForCorrection/ApprovedForPayment, PaymentConfirmed, PermitReleased, ApplicationRejected), each ctor (Application $application, ?User $actor). app/Listeners/SendStatusNotification handles all 7 (NOT ShouldQueue — synchronous), maps event->type/title + body (pulls latest CORRECTION/REJECTION remark body for those two). Registered explicitly via Event::listen in AppServiceProvider::boot() (not relying on auto-discovery). BINDINGS: AppServiceProvider::register binds PaymentGateway=>SandboxGateway (match on permit.payment.mode) and SmsChannel=>LogSmsChannel (match on permit.sms.driver). Contracts in app/Contracts: PaymentGateway{initiate,verify}, SmsChannel{send}. POLICIES (auto-discovered App\Models\X -> App\Policies\XPolicy): ApplicationPolicy@view(owner|staff), @update/@submit(owner && status in DRAFT/FOR_CORRECTION), @review(bplo|admin). PaymentPolicy@pay(owner && APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT), @view(owner|staff). PermitPolicy@download(owner|staff) — NO update ability exists. AUTH: Controllers in app/Http/Controllers/Auth. RegisterController@show/@store (forces role=applicant server-side; role never mass-assigned; logs in, redirects /dashboard). LoginController@show/@authenticate (throttle:5,1 on route; checks is_active before Auth::attempt; redirects by role: admin=>/admin/dashboard, bplo=>/bplo/dashboard, else /dashboard; audits auth.login / auth.login_failed) / @destroy (logout). PasswordResetController uses the built-in Password broker. FormRequests in app/Http/Requests/Auth: RegisterRequest (name/email unique/password confirmed min8 mixedCase+numbers, + optional contact_number/address), LoginRequest. ROUTES: Auth routes added to routes/web.php under guest group (register, login throttle:5,1, forgot-password, reset-password/{token}) + POST /logout (auth). Later FEATs add Applicant/Bplo/Admin/Public route groups. VIEWS: Minimal placeholder Blade views created so GET auth routes + permit PDF render coherently: resources/views/auth/{login,register,forgot-password,reset-password}.blade.php and resources/views/permits/pdf.blade.php (government layout, QR embedded as SVG data-URI top-right). The UI FEAT can restyle/replace these. TESTS added (all green): NumberSequenceTest, ApplicationWorkflowServiceTest, ApplicationPolicyTest, AuthRegistrationTest, PaymentAndPermitGuardTest (Feature) + SandboxGatewayTest (Unit, extends Tests\TestCase because LogSmsChannel uses the Log facade). The deeper end-to-end happy-path / webhook / PDF-QR / no-worker-notification feature tests described in design 'Testability' belong to the controllers/routes FEAT. GOTCHAS: application_remarks.author_id NOT NULL (pass staff actor to return/reject). phpunit.xml forces QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync in tests; the design's 'notifications fire without a worker with QUEUE_CONNECTION=database' assertion must be written in a test that overrides the queue connection. Application model status/tracking_number/submitted_at/reviewed_at are NOT fillable — services set them directly. Pre-existing FEAT-001 Pint nits (models class_attributes_separation, EnsureUserHasRole, bootstrap/app.php) were left untouched as out-of-scope.
